record_title: Outer-parallel deficit identity and smooth rigidity in planar fractional isoperimetry
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The exact deficit identity and equality classification are proved only for C-infinity strictly convex planar bodies, where the outer-parallel first variation applies directly. No equality theorem is claimed for arbitrary C1 domains or nonsmooth convex bodies, and no quantitative geometric-distance remainder is established. Fractional-Willmore rigidity is prior work of Döhrer--Dohmen. Recency leaves residual risk of unindexed simultaneous observations. No independent validation is asserted.
